Tasks.Description: Design and implement a function to generate random posting times within a specified time window. Ensure the function can handle different time zones.

Implement a logging system to record the actual posting times for each post. Ensure the logs include the post ID, scheduled time, and actual posting time.
Create a user interface component to display the posting schedule and logs. Include filters for date range and platform.
Develop a testing suite to verify that the random posting times function generates times within the specified window and that no two posts are scheduled at the same interval.
Integrate the scheduling algorithm with the existing social media posting system to ensure posts are made at the scheduled times.
Implement error handling to manage potential issues such as overlapping posts or failed scheduling attempts. Ensure errors are logged and notifications are sent to the Social Media Manager.
